versos.texto_bv: Houve guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão durante todos os dias da vida dele.
versos.traducao_literal: E guerra houve entre Roboão e entre Jeroboão todos os dias de sua vida.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): BV diz “Roboão” onde NTLH e NVIPT dizem “Abião/Abias”; ARA também tem “Roboão”. O contexto imediato (vv. 7-8: sumário do reinado de Abião com guerra entre Abião e Jeroboão) indica que o verso 6 descreve o conflito durante a vida de Abião, não de Roboão (morto antes da ascensão de Abião). — evidência: NTLH: “Abias e Jeroboão estiveram sempre em guerra”; NVIPT: “guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão durante toda a vida de Abias” (interpreta o pronome como Abião). ARA: “guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão todos os dias da vida de Roboão”. O TM lê רְחַבְעָם (Roboão), mas o contexto narrativo favorece אָבִיָּם (Abião); possível erro de transmissão textual.

kjv.texto: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

vizinhos.5: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
vizinhos.7: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

web.texto: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

vizinhos.5: because David did that which was right in the eyes of Yahweh, and didn’t turn aside from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
vizinhos.7: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
